title: NovelAI text (novelai/text/spec/**/*.json)
description: One prompt per JSON file under novelai/text/spec/, including subfolders. The path relative to novelai/text/spec/ without .json is the spec id. Output filename is that id with .txt (nested folders preserved). Optional novelai/text/system_prompt.json, novelai/text/memory.json, and matching novelai/text/lorebook/ entries are prepended in that order, joined by blank lines, and sent as the single /ai/generate input. Lorebook files activate when the file stem or keys are a case-insensitive substring of this spec's input. When omitted, model is llama-3-erato-v1 and max_length is 100. Trial accounts may only use kayra-v1. Tablet and Scroll cap max_length at 150; Opus at 250.

input.description: Story text to continue from. Also the search window for lorebook keys. Placed last in the assembled /ai/generate input, after system_prompt.json, memory.json, and matching lorebook entries. The saved file is the generated continuation, not this input.

model.description: NovelAI text model. When omitted, llama-3-erato-v1 is used.

max_length.description: Maximum generation length in tokens. When omitted, 100 is used.
